name: Alphalete - Not Indexed Pull 2026-06-16
body:
> Audit · Alphalete · 2026-06-16

# Summary
The GSC not-indexed pull from the height of the June indexing crisis. The site (launched about January 2026) had only **3 pages indexed** and 33 not indexed. The working assumption was to request indexing for the 26 "Crawled - currently not indexed" URLs, but a live check showed the site had been rebuilt and most of those URLs were dead.

# Key findings
- Breakdown at report date: 26 crawled-not-indexed, 6 404, 1 noindex (intentional), 0 discovered-not-indexed.
- The 26 were 14 old `/service-areas/{city}-co` pages, 4 old service pages, 5 core pages and 2 blogs (plus `/sitemap`).
- **Critical finding:** Google rejected Request Indexing on `/service-areas/denver-co` (live 404). A live HTTP check found 23 of 26 were 404; only `/about-us`, `/what-is-trenchless-sewer-repair/` and `/how-often-should-you-hydro-jet/` were live.
- The rebuild (then on Yoast) had about 227 pages under new paths, retargeted from Denver metro to the Colorado Springs area.
- GSC Sitemaps only had the old `/sitemap.xml` (301, 0 pages); the new `sitemap_index.xml` had never been submitted.

# Actions completed that day
1. Submitted `https://alphaletetrenchless.com/sitemap_index.xml` in GSC (Success).
2. Added 22 verified 301s in `.htaccess` (backup `.htaccess.bak-2026-06-16`): old Denver and Littleton city URLs to their new trenchless pages; 12 out-of-area city URLs to the `/service-areas/` hub; old service URLs to the new service pages; contact-us, gallery and projects to their new equivalents.
3. Earlier the same day, indexing requests were not sent because the Chrome session on GSC was unreliable; the file says not to fire blind requests without per-URL confirmation.

# Decisions and status
- Lesson recorded: requesting indexing on a stale GSC list is the wrong move after a rebuild. Redirect dead URLs, submit the right sitemap, then run a fresh not-indexed pass on the new structure.
- Follow-ups at the time: not-indexed pass on new pages; remove the stale `/sitemap.xml` entry from GSC.
